props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by asChild.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

props.name: bubbleSelect
props.description: When true, selecting children will update the parent state. Requires multiple to be true.

props.name: color
props.description: Overrides the accent color inherited from the theme.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: The value of the expanded tree when initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control the state of the expanded tree

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the tree when initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control the state of the tree

props.name: dir
props.description:
The reading direction of the listbox when applicable.
If omitted, inherits globally from ConfigProvider or assumes LTR (left-to-right) reading mode.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with tree

props.name: expanded
props.description: The controlled value of the expanded item. Can be binded with v-model.

props.name: getChildren
props.description: This function is passed the index of each item and should return a list of children for that item

props.name: getKey
props.description: This function is passed the index of each item and should return a unique key for that item

props.name: highContrast
props.description: Uses a higher contrast color for selected tree items.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the tree. Can be binded with v-model.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple options can be selected or not.

props.name: propagateSelect
props.description: When true, selecting parent will select the descendants. Requires multiple to be true.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: How multiple selection should behave in the collection.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the size of each tree row.

props.name: virtual
props.description: Enables virtual rendering, optionally configuring the virtualizer.
